# Toll (t0ll.xyz)

> The safety layer for agentic finance on Robinhood Chain: checks before an AI agent buys, signs or pays (pre-sign checks, x402 payee checks, an x402 facilitator). Coin and product (LARP) checks on Robinhood Chain (4663), read from the chain: who is behind a coin, the dev's record, whether the liquidity can be pulled, and whether there is a real product behind it. Information only, not advice.

## Paid endpoints for agents (x402: USDG on Robinhood Chain, eip155:4663, or the same amount in USDC on Base, eip155:8453)

15 paid routes, each offered on both rails in its 402: check/{token}, larp/{token}, dev/{wallet}, fresh, pulse, hook/{hook}, tx (POST), stock/{id}, markets/fundamentals/{id}, markets/insiders/{id}, markets/institutions/{id}, markets/guidance/{id}, markets/macro, markets/stocks, markets/gaps (all under https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/).


- [Token check](https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/check/{token}): GET, $0.005 USDG. Coin check for any token on Robinhood Chain: snipers in the first 3 s, bundles, who funded the dev, the dev's past launches, holders, liquidity, red flags, as JSON. Replace {token} with a Robinhood Chain token address (?chain=rh). Payment is USDG on Robinhood Chain.
- [LARP check](https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/larp/{token}): GET, $0.005 USDG. Is there a real product behind a coin: reads its site, posts and code and checks every claim against the chain and its own working parts (app, API, MCP server, x402, extension, Telegram bot, public code). Label: found / partly found / not found / not read, a fact about what we could check, never a verdict. Replace {token} with a Robinhood Chain token address (?chain=rh). Charged only for a whole answer: a check still being read answers 402 {"pending": true} (nothing charged, resend the same header after Retry-After); a coin whose words could not be read is free.
- [Deployer history](https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/dev/{wallet}): GET, $0.005 USDG. Every launch by one deployer wallet, how many graduated, and how they ended, as JSON.
- [Fresh launches](https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/fresh?limit=10&chain=rh): GET, $0.01 USDG. The newest coins on Robinhood Chain, newest first, with the live engine's short notes on each (the dev, the first buyers, wallets that moved together, the liquidity), as JSON (&format=text for plain text). limit 1 to 20 (default 10); chain=rh only for now (any other chain is a 400, before any payment). The same list as the MCP tool fresh_launches. A feed that is not updating, or an empty list, is answered free.
- [Chain pulse](https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/pulse): GET, $0.01 USDG. Robinhood Chain right now: launches, graduations and trades, as JSON (no parameter). The same read as the MCP tool chain_pulse.
- [Hook check](https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/hook/{hook}): GET, $0.005 USDG. One Uniswap v4 hook on Robinhood Chain by its address: its name and where it was read (the contract's getter, Blockscout or Sourcify), its 14 permission bits in plain words, whether its owner can change its code (EIP-1967 proxy) or it is a fixed clone, how many pools use it in Toll's chain data, the buy and sell cut measured on a small test trade through its newest pool (or sells fail), and its latest coins with how each ended (the launch record, scored 24 h after launch), as JSON. An address with no code is a 400 before any payment. Free without the measured % and the coin list: GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/hook/{address} (?format=text), and the MCP tool check_hook.
- [Pre-sign check](https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/tx): POST, $0.005 USDG. The transaction ({chainId: 4663, from, to, data, value}), message ({message: {kind: personal_sign | eth_sign, data}, origin}), EIP-712 signature ({typedData}), ERC-4337 user operation ({userOp, entryPoint}), EIP-7702 authorizationList, wallet request as sent ({rpc: {method, params}}) or x402 payment ({x402}) an agent is about to sign, as JSON; the answer is an ERC-8265 RiskAssessment: ALLOW / WARN / BLOCK with the reasons (approvals, transfers, the coin a swap buys and instructions to AI agents in its name or symbol, an x402 payTo against the seller's registered ERC-8004 agentWallet). Calldata it cannot decode is never ALLOW: WARN, and BLOCK when it sends 0.05 ETH or more, or any ETH to an address with no code. It reads personal_sign and eth_sign messages (Sign-In with Ethereum included), any EIP-712 typed data (Permit, Permit2, EIP-3009, Seaport, UniswapX, and any other named field by field), ERC-4337 user operations, and multicall, Safe and smart-account batches leaf by leaf; for a signature it says what it lets someone take (Permit, Permit2, UniswapX, Seaport and EIP-3009: the pull simulated at the current block, in USD where Toll has a price), and an EIP-7702 delegation is WARN for a delegate Toll has verified by code hash and BLOCK for any other. Every text field of EIP-712 typed data (domain name and version, message strings) is scanned for instructions aimed at AI agents (WARN typed-data-text-injection). A single-pool Uniswap v4 swap off the coin's main pool is quoted on the main pool (V4Quoter): WARN swap-route-worse when the main pool pays more than 3% more. Uniswap v4 position manager calls (modifyLiquidities, its multicall, initializePool, permit) are read action by action: liquidity paid out to anyone but from is lp-take-to-other (high), a position minted to another wallet lp-mint-to-other. Bull's agreements and OTC escrow (bull.family) are read: who gets paid, each condition that unlocks it, when it refunds, Bull's fee and the token locked or bought (through the coin check); a payee that can unlock the money alone is bull-payee-can-release (high). Standing power over a smart account is said in plain words: a Safe enableModule / setGuard / setFallbackHandler / owner or threshold change, a Zodiac Roles grant (assignRoles, allowTarget, allowFunction, scopeFunction), a Delay cooldown cut and an ERC-7579 installModule (account-enable-module, account-set-guard, account-fallback-handler, account-owner-change, account-threshold, roles-assign, roles-allow-target, roles-allow-function, delay-cooldown, account-install-module); BLOCK for a module with no code, a fallback handler that is not Safe's own, a threshold of one, a role that may delegatecall or call transfer/approve with any arguments, and a Safe delegatecall to anything but MultiSend or Safe's own helpers. Zodiac Roles scopeFunction conditions are read: a transfer, approve, withdraw or swap whose recipient, receiver or executor field is left open is roles-scope-open-recipient (BLOCK; the 2026-11-16 drain), delegatecall in the options roles-scope-delegatecall (BLOCK), a tree that does not read roles-scope-unread. A Safe created through SafeProxyFactory (createProxyWithNonce and its variants) is opened at creation: owners and threshold (a high warning when any one of several owners alone controls it), the fallback handler, every module its setup enables (enableModules or Safe7579), and any other setup delegatecall (a high warning). A module enabled or installed carries the ERC-7484 registry's word (Rhinestone's registry on Robinhood Chain): attested by N attesters, or no attestation. Priors lab (ERC-8458..8467) calls are named; pass lab_prepare's unsigned tx to check_tx before signing. An x402 upto payment is flagged with its signed maximum, which the seller may charge in full (x402-scheme-upto); an auth-capture payment's escrow, token collector and hold are explained, and an escrow that is not the real one on Robinhood Chain or a signature to the wrong collector is WARN (x402-escrow-unknown, x402-collector-mismatch). It reads and warns before you sign; onchain enforcement is opt-in: a contract can require Toll's signed single-use ALLOW ticket (github.com/t0ll-xyz/toll-allow, https://t0ll.xyz/agents/allow); no partner contract uses it yet. Each delegate is named. It simulates the transaction at the current block (balance changes, approvals, revert) and can compare it with an optional intent ({action: swap|transfer|approve|pay, sellToken, sellAmount in base units, buyToken, minBuy, to, spender, maxAmount, tolerancePct}). A failed simulation is reported as not read, never ALLOW; a transaction without from cannot be simulated and is WARN. Robinhood Chain only (another chain is a 400, before any payment). Free at POST https://t0ll.xyz/api/tx/check within the free coins a day, and over MCP as check_tx.
- [ALLOW tickets](https://t0ll.xyz/agents/allow): add "ticket": true (or {consumer, scope: "call" | "v4swap"}) to the pre-sign check and a qualifying answer carries x-toll.ticket {ticket, signature, signer}: a single-use EIP-712 ticket ("Toll Allow" v1, chain 4663) bound to one exact call, one account and an optional consumer contract, valid 60 s; a BLOCK is never signed, and none is issued without from. A contract can require it with https://github.com/t0ll-xyz/toll-allow; pin Toll's ALLOW signer 0x4A2C93066d94F1E69f3EAd5438c4efDdf80a46ba. A ticket is necessary, never sufficient.
- [Protect RPC](https://t0ll.xyz/agents/allow#rpc): point your agent's wallet at https://t0ll.xyz/api/rpc/protect (JSON-RPC, Robinhood Chain 4663) instead of the chain's RPC. Allowed reads pass through; eth_sendRawTransaction is checked first and a BLOCK is refused (JSON-RPC error -32003) before it reaches the chain; ALLOW and WARN are sent on. The fast path (1.5 s budget) checks fewer things than check_tx (the decode, EIP-7702 delegates, approvals, transfers, undecoded calls with ETH, coin checks Toll already holds; no simulation), unless check_tx ran on the same transaction in the last 30 s; ?mode=strict waits up to 8 s for the full check and refuses WARN too.
- [Toll Markets, one Stock Token](https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/stock/{id}): GET, $0.02 USDG. One Robinhood Stock Token by ticker (NVDA) or contract: Chainlink's reference price read on chain with the US session, the deepest pool's price and liquidity, the difference vs the reference, supply, multiplier, corporate actions, the company's SEC facts and latest filings; every number with its source and time. Charged only when a reference or a chain price was read; a ticker Robinhood does not list is 404, not charged. Free at https://t0ll.xyz/api/markets/stock/{id} within the Markets calls a day.
- [How to pay](https://t0ll.xyz/agents/x402): no payment returns 402 with the x402 requirements (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, v1 body). Pay with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1). Settled only when the read is whole; on 402 {"pending": true}, resend the same header after Retry-After. If key parts (holders, launch, the dev's record) still cannot be read after a few minutes, the partial answer is free: {"charged": false, "why": "partial", "missing": [...]}. A settled payment resent gets the same answer and receipt, never a second charge. Robinhood Chain (USDG) payments are verified and settled by Toll's own facilitator (https://x402.t0ll.xyz), with the Priors facilitator as the fallback when ours cannot settle; Base (USDC) payments are verified and settled by the PayAI facilitator. Either way the money goes to Toll's wallet 0xdC36D51963d08862c525045ccFD39FAe6a0C7F40.
- [Discovery list](https://t0ll.xyz/.well-known/x402): the paid resources as JSON.
- [Launch feed](https://t0ll.xyz/toll#feed): GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/feed/launches?since=<unix s>&limit=1..100 with a Toll key (x-toll-pass). Every new coin on Robinhood Chain with Toll's check at launch, oldest first, with a `next` cursor for the following ask; poll every 15 s. Team holders (20M+ $TOLL) live, Pro (5M+) 15 minutes late. A paid plan opens after $TOLL graduates.

## Toll Markets (data on Robinhood Stock Tokens, free within a daily count)

- [Markets](https://t0ll.xyz/markets): every Stock Token Robinhood lists on Robinhood Chain, each with Chainlink's reference price (fresh, stale, or market closed), the chain's own price, supply, corporate actions and SEC filings. Robinhood Stock Tokens are debt securities issued by Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Ltd, not shares.
- API: GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/markets/stocks?q=&limit= (the list) and GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/markets/stock/{ticker|address} (one). Markets calls a day: Free 50, Builder 1,000, Pro 5,000, Team 20,000 (by $TOLL held; send a Toll key as x-toll-pass), counted apart from coin checks. Paid with no daily limit: https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/stock/{id}, 0.02 USDG.
- MCP: stock_token(id) for one token (with a short fundamentals summary), stock_tokens(query?, limit?) for the list.
- Company numbers: GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/markets/fundamentals/{ticker|address} (MCP fundamentals(id, period?: ttm|annual|quarterly)): SEC EDGAR XBRL statements (TTM = four contiguous quarters, "TTM to <end>"; the last 4 fiscal years; the last 8 quarters), margins, YoY growth, the latest balance sheet, shares outstanding with its date, 8 quarters of revenue and diluted EPS with YoY, and market cap and P/E at the Chainlink reference only when one share count, the multiplier and a current reference allow it (else null with the reason). Values worked out from filed figures are labelled derived; EPS is never summed across quarters. P/E pairs a live price with EPS up to ~3 months old.
- Insider trades: GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/markets/insiders/{ticker|address}?limit=1..200 (MCP insider_trades(id, limit?)): SEC Form 4 filings of the last 90 days (newest 40 at most, the window stated), rows with owner, relationship, code in words, signed shares, price or "see footnote", owned after, Rule 10b5-1 flag, filing link; 4/A replaces its original; plus the Schedule 13D/G filings naming the company (filer not read yet).
- Institutions (13F): GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/markets/institutions/{ticker|address} (MCP institutions(id, limit?)): from SEC's quarterly Form 13F data sets, the top 20 managers by shares for the latest quarter with each one's change vs the prior quarter (only managers that filed both; new = null, not 0), total institutional shares, filer count, and the change over managers in both quarters; puts and calls left out, amendments applied, a value filed in thousands flagged. Every answer states "13F for the quarter ended <date>, SEC data set published <date>". Funds and foreign issuers: not covered; a ticker with no reviewed CUSIP: 13F not mapped. 13F shares are the company's, not the Stock Token's.
- Earnings releases (AI-extracted from cited filings): GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/markets/guidance/{ticker|address} (MCP guidance(id, limit?)): from the last 4 SEC 8-K Item 2.02 earnings releases (the press release exhibit), the company's forward guidance (low/high, a single figure, or words only), KPIs, non-GAAP measures and the GAAP lines they reconcile from, each with its period, its quote (at most 300 characters) and the filing link. A model picked each value's sentence or table cell; every number was read from that quote by code; unreadable figures and GAAP lines that disagree with XBRL were dropped. Read once per release, never per request. Funds and foreign issuers (6-K) are not covered.
- Macro: GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/markets/macro (MCP macro()): Treasury daily par yield curve, the New York Fed's EFFR with its date and target range, BLS CPI-U YoY, unemployment rate, nonfarm payrolls change (P = preliminary). The EFFR is subject to the Terms of Use posted at newyorkfed.org; Toll is not affiliated with the New York Fed.
- Stock feed: GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/markets/feed?since=<last id>&limit=1..100&kind= with a Toll key (x-toll-pass) (MCP stock_events(since?, kind?, limit?)): listed / delisted, multiplier_scheduled / multiplier_applied, corporate_action, feed_stale / feed_paused / feed_resumed, filing (8-K, 10-Q, 10-K, Form 4, 13D/G; funds and tickers with no SEC CIK get none), oldest first by id with `next`; every answer has poller_as_of. Team live, Pro 15 minutes late; MCP without a key: the last 10 events an hour late, free.
- Holders (GeckoTerminal, with its as-of; includes pools and custody contracts) and 24 h volume over every pool (GeckoTerminal) are in the free one-token answer and stock_token, not in x402 answers.
- Paid with no daily limit, 0.01 USDG each, charged only when the numbers were read: https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/markets/fundamentals/{id}, https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/markets/insiders/{id}, https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/markets/institutions/{id}, https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/markets/guidance/{id}, https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/markets/macro, https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/markets/stocks (every Stock Token with its Chainlink reference, no parameter) and https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/markets/gaps (every feed's chain price vs Chainlink, its age and the 5% / 4 h flags, no parameter). A ticker Robinhood does not list is a 404 before any price is quoted. Each free call counts one Markets call.
- Robinhood's own quote is not in any API, MCP or x402 answer. Information only, not advice. Toll is not affiliated with Robinhood or Chainlink. Stock Tokens are not offered to US persons and are restricted elsewhere; this data is not an offer.

## MCP server (free, no auth)

- [Toll MCP](https://t0ll.xyz/mcp): remote MCP server, Streamable HTTP, no authentication. Also served at https://t0ll.xyz/api/mcp (the address in our ERC-8004 registration). Reads Robinhood Chain (4663). Tools: check_coin(address) for a token check on Robinhood Chain (snipers, bundles, wallets that moved together, dev record, holders, liquidity, findings); pre_buy_check(address) for one decision right before a buy on Robinhood Chain: BLOCK / WARN / ALLOW / WAIT with up to 3 reasons, on the same calibrated rules as check_tx (calibration window 2026-10-13..10-29); WAIT: ask again after the seconds given; one free coin, as check_coin; check_coins(addresses) for up to 20 Robinhood Chain coins at once from checks Toll already holds (verdict word each, or not read yet; reads nothing new, no free coin used); larp_check(token) for the LARP check, is there a real product behind a coin (Robinhood Chain; label found / partly found / not found / not read; with HEY Research's independent builder facts when HEY has a record (cited, never part of the label); a coin nobody asked about yet is queued, ask again after the seconds it gives); launch_record(address) for the call Toll froze a few minutes after a Robinhood Chain coin launched and how it ended 24 hours later; dev_record(wallet) for every launch by a deployer (Robinhood Chain); wallet_privacy(wallet) for a privacy grade and leaks; wallet_approvals(wallet) for its live token approvals (ERC-20, NFT approval-for-all, Permit2) with a risk each and the revoke transaction checked by check_tx; account_permissions(address) for who can move a Safe or smart account's funds without the owners (modules, Zodiac Roles members and grants, Delay, guard, fallback handler, ERC-7579 modules; parts not read are said); fresh_launches(limit up to 20) for the newest coins; chain_pulse() for launches, graduations and trades right now (these three: Robinhood Chain only); check_tx(to, data, value, from | message | typedData | userOp | authorizationList | rpc | x402) for the pre-sign check before signing on Robinhood Chain: ALLOW / WARN / BLOCK with the reasons (an ERC-8265 RiskAssessment), and on BLOCK do not sign without your owner's say; presign_risk_report(...) for the same read as a signed Agent Pre-Sign Risk Report (our ERC, https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/2134); stock_token(id) and stock_tokens(query?, limit?) for Robinhood Stock Tokens, fundamentals(id, period?), insider_trades(id, limit?), institutions(id, limit?), guidance(id, limit?) and macro() for the company's numbers, Form 4 insider trades, 13F institutional holders, what its earnings releases said (AI-extracted from cited filings) and US macro (Toll Markets, its own free count a day); check_agent(id) for one ERC-8004 agent registered on Robinhood Chain: whether its card loads, whether it answers over MCP or x402, its x402 payTo and whether that is its registered agentWallet, whether its wallet has sent a transaction, last check and changes (facts with the date and source read, never a verdict; free, no coin quota); find_paid_api(query?, limit?) for paid APIs (x402) to buy on Robinhood Chain: each resource, its price, payTo, whether that payTo is the seller's registered agent wallet (verified) and payments settled through Toll, verified first, one row per operator unless you name it (the same list as https://x402.t0ll.xyz/discovery/resources and /discovery/search; free); check_hook(address) for one Uniswap v4 hook on Robinhood Chain: its name, what its address lets it do, whether its owner can change its code, how many pools use it, and whether sells through it fail (a $TOLL holder's Toll key adds the measured cut and how its latest coins ended). Each answer ends with a link to the full page.
- Free limit: 25 new coins a day per caller over MCP (coins already read stay free). Past it, check_coin's answer ends with the paid x402 URL for that coin (https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/check/{token}?chain=...) and how to pay, and larp_check's with https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/larp/{token}?chain=rh (one quota for both). Without a key MCP is counted by IP. Holders of $TOLL get more new coins a day (1M: 100, 5M: 500, 20M: 2,000; https://t0ll.xyz/toll): make a Toll key at https://t0ll.xyz/toll#keys and send it as Authorization: Bearer <key> (or x-toll-pass) on MCP and /api/check. No daily limit: x402.
- [Toll A2A](https://t0ll.xyz/.well-known/agent-card.json): the same tools over Agent2Agent (A2A 1.0 and 0.3, JSON-RPC at https://t0ll.xyz/a2a): send a message with a token address (add "should I buy" for one decision), or a data part {"skill": "<tool>", "input": {...}}. One Message back, the same text as MCP, the same free coins.
- Coin watches (webhooks): with a Toll key, watch_coin(address, url) over MCP (or POST https://t0ll.xyz/api/watch {token, url}) watches a Robinhood Chain coin; Toll re-reads it about every 10 minutes, and sooner after a trade or liquidity change (with more watched coins it takes longer), and POSTs a signed JSON event to your https url when its verdict word changes, a new finding against appears, or the dev's or a launch wallet group's sold share rises 5 points or more ({type:"toll.watch", event: verdict_changed | new_against | dev_sold | cluster_sold, token, verdict:{before, now}, new_against, sold, check_url}; events and payloads: https://t0ll.xyz/watch; header x-toll-signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, raw body)>, the secret shown once). my_watches() lists them, unwatch_coin(id) removes one. Cap by $TOLL held: 3 / 20 / 50 / 100. The first read sends nothing; 5 failed deliveries pause a watch.
- Wallet watches (webhooks): with a Toll key, watch_wallet(address, url) over MCP (or POST https://t0ll.xyz/api/watch/wallet {address, url}) watches a Robinhood Chain wallet; Toll reads it about once a minute and POSTs a signed JSON event ({type:"toll.wallet_watch", event, events:[...], address, blocks:{from, to}}) when it gives a new token approval (approval: token, spender, amount "unlimited" / "all" / base units, kind erc20 | nft-all | permit2, tx, block), signs a new EIP-7702 delegation (delegation: delegate, previous) or receives a token whose Toll check is against (risky_token_in: token, amount, from, verdict, tx, check_url), and, for a smart account (a Safe, a Zodiac Roles or Delay module, an ERC-7579 account), when who can move its funds changes (account_permission: account, change such as module-enabled / owner-added / threshold-changed / role-assigned / module-installed, source, grantee, value, severity critical | high | medium, message, tx, block); same x-toll-signature, the secret shown once; the first read sends nothing. my_watches() lists coin and wallet watches together, unwatch_wallet(id) removes one (REST: GET / DELETE https://t0ll.xyz/api/watch/wallet). Wallet watches have their own cap, the same size as coin watches (3 / 20 / 50 / 100). Page: https://t0ll.xyz/watch
- [Open blocklist](https://t0ll.xyz/blocklist): a free, machine-readable list of Robinhood Chain coins Toll's own stored reads put at BLOCK (sells that fail through the pool's hook, a finding pre_buy_check blocks on, rugged or launch liquidity removed within 24 h on /record), each with reason codes, first_seen / last_confirmed and an evidence link (+ the pull tx when stored). GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/blocklist (JSON; ?format=csv or txt, ?since=<ISO>, ?kind=token), ETag, no key, 30 a minute. Free to use, attribution "Toll, t0ll.xyz". A coin not listed is not cleared.
- [Pre-sign record](https://t0ll.xyz/agents/record): every check_tx answer (ALLOW / WARN / BLOCK) that named a coin bought or approved, scored 24 hours later by whether the coin rugged, died or kept trading (no wallet kept), plus the coin check's calibration re-run every week beside the rates in code. JSON: GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/record/tx
- [Rules & thresholds](https://t0ll.xyz/agents/rules): every rule that makes check_tx / pre_buy_check say BLOCK, the main WARN rules and every coin finding's tier, with the threshold, the measured share of coins that rugged and the sample size, generated from the code. JSON: https://t0ll.xyz/api/rules (free).
- [Audits](https://t0ll.xyz/agents/audits): Toll's own security and accuracy audits (17 Nov 2026), every finding with its status and the measured false-BLOCK rates. Toll's own work, not an outside firm's.
- [Benchmark](https://t0ll.xyz/benchmark): Toll's launch calls (filed ~3 minutes after launch, frozen before the outcome) scored on a fixed sample of 200 Robinhood Chain coins with known 24 h outcomes (100 rugged, 100 still trading or graduated): share of rugged coins called against, share of survivors called against, not-answered share, and every rugged coin Toll did not call against. The sample rule, the method and the data are published (https://t0ll.xyz/data/benchmark-2026-11-08.json).
- [Safety layer](https://t0ll.xyz/agents/safety): everything the pre-sign check reads before an agent signs, by kind: a simulated run of the transaction (eth_simulateV1) with intent vs effect and batches opened call by call; the coin's main pool quoted against the one a v4 swap uses; Uniswap v4 liquidity calls (payouts and positions to another wallet); what a signature lets someone take, simulated in USD (Permit2, Seaport, UniswapX, EIP-3009, EIP-712, SIWE; eth_sign is BLOCK); the x402 payment and its seller (payee, price drift, long authorizations, standing Permit2, upto maximums, auth-capture escrow and collector); hidden instructions, the text inside EIP-712 signatures included; and the ways to make the answer binding (guard, ALLOW tickets, Protect RPC).
- [Approvals & revoke](https://t0ll.xyz/approvals): a wallet's live token approvals on Robinhood Chain, each with a revoke transaction checked by check_tx (MCP wallet_approvals).
- [Account permissions](https://t0ll.xyz/account): who can move a Safe or smart account's funds on Robinhood Chain without the owners signing: modules, Zodiac Roles members and what each may call, Delay, guard, fallback handler (MCP account_permissions, GET /api/account/{addr}).
- [Ask Toll](https://t0ll.xyz/ask): a plain-language question answered only from Toll's own read tools (at most 4 runs), each fact naming its tool; numbers, verdicts and addresses are checked against the tool results, else the raw results come back. Facts, not advice (MCP ask_toll, POST /api/ask {question, address?}).
- [Speed & uptime](https://t0ll.xyz/status): p50 and p95 answer times per door (whole and cold) and the share answered, last 24 h and 7 d, from Toll's own check log.
- Stock tokens while the US market is closed (weekends, NYSE holidays; the 24/5 feeds keep updating overnight): Chainlink's answer is the last close, so stock_token, the coin check, pre_buy_check and check_tx say "market closed since <time>; the pool trades X% above/below the last close reference"; past 5% it is a WARN (code stock-closed-drift: the reference is the last close; the pool price is not backed by a live market). The token's ERC-8056 multiplier (uiMultiplier / newUIMultiplier / effectiveAt, read on chain) is shown as "1 token = N shares since <date>"; a change in the last 30 days or one set for later is named (stock-multiplier-recent / stock-multiplier-pending, low), and a reference updated before the current multiplier took effect is not compared.
- Copycat tickers: the coin check, pre_buy_check and check_tx flag a coin whose ticker (case, $, spaces, hidden characters and lookalike letters folded; no fuzzy match) is a Robinhood Stock Token's, a base asset's (USDG, WETH, ETH, USDC, USDT, BTC, WBTC) or a known memecoin's ($TOLL, or a coin on Toll's market list with a $100k+ market cap that launched earlier and is bigger) on another contract, with the real one's address (warning code coin-copycat: Stock Token or base asset copy high, a Stock Token's plain ticker and memecoin copies medium; all WARN). The original is never flagged.
- Stable codes: an answer that is not one ends with a line `Code: <word>` over MCP, and has a `code` field on /api/check: still_reading, busy, over_quota, rate_limited, bad_address, chain_off, unavailable, read_failed. Branch on the word; the sentence can change.
- Telegram watch: a Robinhood Chain coin's /api/check and paid /api/x402/check JSON has `watch.telegram` (https://t.me/t0ll_bot?start=w_<token without 0x>_a), and a whole check_coin, pre_buy_check, launch_record or larp_check answer carries the same link ending _m. Where it sits says how much it matters: on a careful or against check_coin answer, and on a WARN or BLOCK pre_buy_check, it comes near the top (under the verdict and tallies, or under the Decision and Token lines) as "This coin can change: get told when it does. ..."; on a clear or ALLOW answer it is the last line before the link, "Watch it: ...". One tap puts the coin on Toll's Telegram bot, which sends a message when the coin's check moves between clear, careful and against, with what changed; 3 coins free. Pass it on to the user. After a WARN or WAIT, pre_buy_check also names the agent's own next call, `Next: watch_coin {"address": "0x...", "url": "<your https webhook>"}` (a signed webhook; needs a Toll key).
- One sign-in: signing in with a wallet on t0ll.xyz (Sign-In with Ethereum) lasts 7 days and holds on every t0ll.xyz host (t0ll.xyz and x402.t0ll.xyz); linking Telegram uses it too, with no second signature. It proves a wallet and moves nothing; the $TOLL tier is still read live on every gated page.
- Orbio (orbio.so) in check_tx: calls to Orbio's Exchange 0x6951ffd32630b05e06f50062aea801625a58ebc0 (buy, buyAndActivate, sell, claimProceeds, claimProceedsAsOrbio, claimReturnedCredit, cancel, cancelMany), CREDIT 0xe33322da1380e61e5ae5dfb21e7f62924c73004c (activate) and the agent vault 0x0e1651aec67b2a049a4fa6aeb6c1c305aabfc35b (launch, claimCredit, withdrawPrincipal, exit, setAgentWallet, harvest) are decoded from Orbio's verified source (Sourcify); a buy with minCreditOut 0 is WARN orbio-min-credit-zero (medium), a claim, activation or agent wallet pointed at an address other than from is orbio-pays-other (high), an approval to the Exchange, vault or Staking 0xe0710011278bfb63e57c5f227e5980984b1eddca is judged as a known contract (unlimited = medium), and the simulation names the CREDIT balance change.
- Plain words: add "summary": true (and "lang": "ar" for Arabic) to the POST https://t0ll.xyz/api/tx/check body for x-toll.summary, 1-2 sentences written by AI from the action and warnings, opening with the action word; every number is checked against the warnings and a line that fails is dropped, never shown; at most 2.5 s, else no field. On by default in the MCP check_tx text (summary: false leaves it out); GET /api/account/{addr}?summary=1 adds ai_summary. POST /api/alert/text turns a watch webhook payload into plain alert text (no AI).
- Plain-language intent and verified-source lines (check_tx / POST /api/tx/check): send "intentText" (at most 300 characters, e.g. "swap 10 USDG for HOOD, send to my wallet") instead of intent and Toll's AI reads it into the structured intent (x-toll.intent.understood; tokens only ETH, WETH, USDG, an official Stock Token or a coin the transaction names, an address only when the text holds it, fields left out listed in x-toll.intent.refused), then compares it like intent; not read in time = low warning intent-text-not-read. A call Toll cannot decode to a contract with verified source gets a low line source-explained from Toll's AI, read from that function's verified source (who receives value, who gains control): not a verdict, and it never lowers the action.
- Trading bots with a timeout: add budgetMs (300-30000, your timeout minus your own round trip, e.g. 1100 for a 1.5 s timeout) to the POST https://t0ll.xyz/api/tx/check body, or budget_ms to pre_buy_check over MCP. The answer comes within it: a coin not read in time is WARN coin-not-read with Retry-After (pre_buy_check: WAIT), never a hang, and the read goes on so the next call is fast; the signed pre-sign report is left out when it is not ready. Each stage's time is in the Server-Timing header.
- ERC-8478 payee verification (x402): the pre-sign check (check_tx / POST /api/tx/check with {x402, agentId?, registry?}) checks an x402 payTo against the seller's ERC-8004 agentWallet or a signed payee delegation (EIP-712), on Robinhood Chain and Base registries; one of nine outcomes; mismatch or invalid delegation = BLOCK. Add strict: true and every outcome other than verified-wallet / verified-delegation (not read included) is BLOCK too, for agents whose policy refuses unbound sellers.
- [@tollxyz/guard](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tollxyz/guard): one line in front of an agent's wallet (viem WalletClient, ethers Signer, or an x402 fetch): Toll's pre-sign check sends what it signs to the check before it is signed: transactions, x402 payments, personal_sign and eth_sign messages (Sign-In with Ethereum included), any EIP-712 typed data (Permit, Permit2, EIP-3009, Seaport, UniswapX, and any other named field by field), ERC-4337 user operations, and multicall, Safe and smart-account batches leaf by leaf; BLOCK throws, WARN is reported. Since 0.6.0 it fails closed: when Toll cannot or will not answer (unreachable, a timeout, 429, 5xx, or a request it refuses to read such as one over its size limit) nothing is signed and the guard throws TollUnavailableError; `failOpen: true` is the opt-in to go ahead unchecked. With a spend policy, a spend it cannot read is refused too (`onUnknownSpend: "allow"` opts out).
- [Setup for each AI app](https://t0ll.xyz/agents/mcp): Claude Code `claude mcp add --transport http toll https://t0ll.xyz/mcp`, plus Claude desktop, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI and Windsurf.
- [Server card](https://t0ll.xyz/.well-known/mcp.json): name, URL, transport and tools as JSON.
- [OpenAPI 3.1](https://t0ll.xyz/openapi.json): the free GET reads /api/check, /api/deployer, /api/privacy and /api/product/ask (the LARP check: q = a Robinhood Chain contract; state done / queued / reading / failed / unavailable, or over_quota), /api/agent/{id} (one ERC-8004 agent's census check, JSON or ?format=text) and /api/hook/{address} (one Uniswap v4 hook, JSON or ?format=text), for GPT Actions and LangChain.

## Identity

- [ERC-8004 registration](https://t0ll.xyz/.well-known/agent-registration.json): Toll is ERC-8004 agent #20030 on Robinhood Chain, identity registry eip155:4663:0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432. Agent hub: https://t0ll.xyz/agents
- [Agent census](https://t0ll.xyz/agents/census): every ERC-8004 agent on Robinhood Chain, which cards load and which answer over MCP or x402. One agent: https://t0ll.xyz/agents/census?agent={id}, as JSON at https://t0ll.xyz/api/agent/{id} (free, 30 reads a minute; ?format=text for plain text). Live from the census job once it has checked the agent, else the 2026-10-28 snapshot; `source` says which and when.
- [ERC-8470 Launch Observations](https://t0ll.xyz/observations): block-pinned facts an agent reads before it buys a token. Our registry is live on Robinhood Chain at 0x730e3c356299c9203cb042f6c0a9274aeabf9af3 and our detector writes to it. Discussion: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/pre-erc-launch-observations-the-check-an-agent-reads-before-it-buys-a-token/30112 . PR: https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/2121
- [ERC-8478 x402 payee check](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/2132): whether an x402 payTo belongs to the seller's ERC-8004 identity; used by check_tx and by our facilitator https://x402.t0ll.xyz
- [Agent Pre-Sign Risk Report](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/2134): typed, signed facts about a prepared request before an agent signs it; served by presign_risk_report
- Hidden instructions in the pre-sign report: published as erc.presign.text.injection (ERC-8481) on every text it reads (token name and symbol, the text fields of EIP-712 typed data, context.texts such as agent.card and payment.description), the classes matched (override, value-transfer, tool-call, safety-claim, secret-request, concealment) under the pattern set at https://t0ll.xyz/erc8481/injection-patterns-v1.json (param {uri, hash}, hash = keccak256 of the file).
- AI second check for hidden instructions: text the pattern rules pass (coin name, ticker and description, personal_sign messages, EIP-712 text fields, x402 descriptions, agent cards) is also asked of a small Claude model whether it tries to instruct an AI agent. It can only add a warning, never remove one: careful on a coin (never against or BLOCK), WARN ai-text-injection (medium) on a signature; not answered in time = the rules alone. The signed ERC-8481 report carries the rules only. Still not perfect.

## Plugins & SDKs

Code: https://github.com/t0ll-xyz/toll-plugins (MIT). Page: https://t0ll.xyz/agents/plugins. Free: 25 new coins a day; past that, x402 at 0.005 USDG on Robinhood Chain.

- [toll-sdk](https://github.com/t0ll-xyz/toll-plugins/tree/main/packages/sdk-py): Python client (import toll_sdk). `pip install toll-sdk`

- [@tollxyz/ai-sdk](https://github.com/t0ll-xyz/toll-plugins/tree/main/packages/ai-sdk): Vercel AI SDK tools. `npm install @tollxyz/ai-sdk ai zod`
- [@tollxyz/goat-plugin](https://github.com/t0ll-xyz/toll-plugins/tree/main/packages/goat): GOAT SDK plugin, deprecated (GOAT upstream archived 2026-07-02; use @tollxyz/ai-sdk, @tollxyz/langchain or @tollxyz/mcp). `npm install @tollxyz/goat-plugin @goat-sdk/core zod@3`
- [Guarded agent](https://github.com/t0ll-xyz/toll-plugins/tree/main/examples/guarded-agent): example agent that will not buy until Toll's check passes (source only).
- [Agent skill](https://t0ll.xyz/skill.md): when to call Toll (before buying a coin, before paying or trusting an ERC-8004 agent), how to read the answers, and the line to add Toll in OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, ElizaOS, AgentKit, GOAT, the AI SDK, LangChain and Mastra.

## Trading a Hookr launch (hookr.fun, Robinhood Chain)

Toll is listed in the Hookr universe under Agents (https://hookr.fun/integrations#universe). Steps: https://t0ll.xyz/hooks/hookr#agents
- Before buying: MCP pre_buy_check(address) at https://t0ll.xyz/mcp answers BLOCK / WARN / ALLOW / WAIT with up to 3 reasons; on WAIT call again after the seconds given; on BLOCK do not buy without the user's say. When the fresh read is not whole yet and Toll holds a whole check of the coin read in the last 30 minutes, pre_buy_check and check_coin answer from that last whole check, and the answer says how old it is ("Made from our last whole read, 6 min ago" / "This is our last read, from 6 min ago") instead of WAIT or still reading; a fresh read that already blocks is never replaced by an older one.
- Before signing: check_tx (or POST https://t0ll.xyz/api/tx/check with {chainId: 4663, from, to, data, value}) decodes HookrRouter (0xc2bc9a3fe6c4ce8c2f7eb4655b0869b01d8c93c9) swap, swapFor and swapGated: the coin bought through Toll's coin check, a payout to anyone but from flagged, and Hookr's Agent gate read for the wallet (a refusal is WARN: the swap would revert). An ERC-6551 agent wallet's execute() is read through and the swap checked as sent from the agent wallet. The liquidity calls Hookr's MCP builds (hookr_build_add_liquidity, hookr_build_remove_liquidity, hookr_build_collect_fees, on Uniswap's v4 PositionManager) are read step by step: a payout to anyone but from is high (lp-take-to-other), a position minted to another wallet is WARN (lp-mint-to-other).
- Recipe, two steps: 1. build the call with Hookr's MCP (https://hookr.fun/api/mcp: hookr_build_swap, hookr_build_launch, hookr_build_claim, hookr_build_agent_link, hookr_build_fill, hookr_build_revenue_claim, hookr_build_reviewer_set, the liquidity builders) for your wallet; 2. pass each call it returns ({to, data, value}, with from = that wallet) to check_tx before signing. On BLOCK do not sign without the user's say; pass every warning on.
- What check_tx reads of those calls besides swaps: HookrLauncher launch / launchAdvised / launchWithBuy / launchFamily (0x70a66adf39b5c9ffee4a9f081c182edfbb7dbd0c for new pools, 0x1cf2748a6670572425eabf9ab9e5bc4eb2eb8ef4: the token, the pools, who holds the liquidity, a dev buy; a hook that is not Hookr's, rules or an add-on we have not read are WARN), its withdraw / withdrawWithClaims (what hookr_build_remove_liquidity and hookr_build_collect_fees build for a launch's own position) and claimRecapture, a pool core's claim / claimTo / claimAsClaims, the Agent gate's link / linkWithProof / unlink / registerReviewers (0xf95e6c8eeda88b4d8dfd43a087d153059a5107b0, 0x3b1ac66a6fd9e9d8f063d145003cf29eac4fb0c9) and the order book's fill / cancel / claimBounty (0x0c376cc30b1ac98b8ef80a4f516212d3b99402fa). Each carries hookr-contract (low: named, not audited); one that pays or points at anyone but from is hookr-pays-other (high). Any other function of those contracts is calldata-undecoded. Hookr's revenue token rHOOKR (0x223e02970326b95098dbf51a6a5ea70f3ed38016): claimAll / claim pay the sender's income to `to` (a `to` that is not the sender is WARN); a revenue token we have not named stays undecoded (WARN).
- The pool's hook: check_hook(address), e.g. Hookr's root hook 0x89c9fb50d1f03192230ffb1c279bb6e7d3fe6acc: name, permission bits, whether its owner can change its code, pools using it, whether sells fail.
- Where a hooked coin's trading fees go, and who can still change that: Undertow by Bucks (ERC-8004 agent #8811), a paid x402 read through Toll's facilitator, 0.10 USDG: GET https://bucks-check.vercel.app/undertow/summary?token=<token> (10 for 1 USDG: /undertow/pack). Not Toll's read; check_tx the payment first.
- Binding: add "ticket": {"scope": "v4swap", "consumer": "0xYourRouter"} to check_tx for a single-use ALLOW ticket bound to the HookrRouter swap's pool, direction, amount and price limit (never for a BLOCK); or send through the Protect RPC https://rpc.t0ll.xyz, where a BLOCK never reaches the chain; or wrap the wallet with @tollxyz/guard.

## x402 facilitator (settle USDG on Robinhood Chain)

Toll runs a keyless x402 facilitator at `https://x402.t0ll.xyz` (the same endpoints are also served under `https://t0ll.xyz/api/facilitator/`): `GET https://x402.t0ll.xyz/supported`, `POST https://x402.t0ll.xyz/verify`, `POST https://x402.t0ll.xyz/settle`, `GET https://x402.t0ll.xyz/receipt/<id or tx>`, `GET https://x402.t0ll.xyz/stats`.
- Fee: none. The seller receives the full amount the payer signed, and the facilitator pays the gas.
- `POST /verify` and `POST /settle` take the x402 body (v1 or v2, scheme exact; v2 scheme upto through Permit2: the payer signs a maximum, the seller settles what it used; USDG on eip155:4663) and answer the x402 shapes.
- Every settlement transaction carries an ERC-8021 builder code (`toll`, plus the seller's app code when its requirements send one).
- Escrow with refunds (x402 v2 scheme `auth-capture`, live since 2026-11-10): the payer's USDG is held in the v1.0 escrow `0xBdEA0D1bcC5966192B070Fdf62aB4EF5b4420cff` (v1.1 has no code on chain 4663 and is refused); the seller captures what it delivered, refunds, or voids the rest, each step a `POST /settle` with `payload.type` signed by the seller's receiverAuthorizer; refunds are funded by the seller; the payer can reclaim after the capture deadline. `GET /api/facilitator/hold?id=<paymentInfoHash>` reads a hold; holds and refunds are listed on https://x402.t0ll.xyz/#escrow.
- Batch settlement (x402 v2 scheme `batch-settlement`, facilitator-managed vouchers, live since 2026-11-10): the payer deposits once into a channel on x402BatchSettlement `0x4020074e9dF2ce1deE5A9C1b5c3f541D02a10003`, then signs a cumulative voucher per request with no transaction and no gas; claims are batched on chain, the rest is refundable. For sub-cent and high-frequency agent payments.
- Pay in more tokens (x402 v2 scheme `exact` through Permit2, `extra.assetTransferMethod` "permit2", live since 2026-11-11): the payer signs one Permit2 transfer for the exact price to the x402ExactPermit2Proxy, and the money can only go to payTo. Only the tokens on this facilitator's list are settled, each read on chain first and listed with its decimals and limits under the exact kind in `GET /supported`; any other token is refused (`unsupported_asset`). A payer that has not approved Permit2 for the token gets `permit2_allowance_required`: approve it once, then pay again.
- Safety screen (extension `toll-screen`): every payment is also read by check_tx; the seller gets `extensions.screen = { outcome: allow | warn | block | not-read, codes }` in the verify and settle answers. Report-only: a slow read never blocks a payment.
- Discovery: `GET https://x402.t0ll.xyz/discovery/resources` and `GET /discovery/search?query=` list every x402 seller on Robinhood Chain, verified payees first (page: https://t0ll.xyz/x402/discover; MCP tool `find_paid_api`). A listing belongs to its payTo: a payment from another wallet that names a seller's URL is a listing of its own, and it never carries the seller's verified mark, name or settled count.
- Job recipes: https://x402.t0ll.xyz/jobs lists jobs an agent can do for a client with paid x402 tools on Robinhood Chain: the tools in order, each tool's price read from its own 402, who it pays, and a price to suggest. As JSON: `GET https://x402.t0ll.xyz/api/x402/jobs`. Over MCP: `find_job`.
- List your own job: a registered ERC-8004 agent's owner or agent wallet signs the EIP-712 message `Job` (domain "Toll Jobs", version "1", chainId 4663) and POSTs `{ job, signature }` to `https://x402.t0ll.xyz/api/x402/jobs`. Every call must answer HTTP 402 with a USDG price on Robinhood Chain. Up to 5 jobs an agent. No account, no key.
- Get checked by Toll (hire): two paid jobs, 5 USDG each, paid through Toll's own x402 facilitator to agent #20030. Agent check: `GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/hire/agent/{id}` (an ERC-8004 agent id on Robinhood Chain): its card, MCP, x402, payTo against its registered agentWallet, the wallet's activity. Launch check: `GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/hire/launch/{token}` (a token on Robinhood Chain): the full coin check (dev record, snipers, bundles, LP, holders). Optional `?x=@handle` for the draft post. Each answers 402 first; only a whole read is settled, a half read is free and says what was missing. The answer is a facts-only report with a share card and a draft X post (no contract address; Toll never posts it; facts, never a judgement of the product). Receipt: `GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/hire/receipt/{tx}` (the paying transaction), with one free retest a day (`&fresh=1`). Page: https://x402.t0ll.xyz/hire.
- Verify your agent (sellers): a seller is verified when its x402 payTo is its ERC-8004 agentWallet. An agent minted by a platform and then sent to its user has none set, because the registry clears it on every transfer. `GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/verify-agent?id=<agent id>` says verified / no agent wallet set / payTo differs / no payTo on record, with the owner, the agent wallet and the payTo; https://t0ll.xyz/x402/verify (also https://x402.t0ll.xyz/verify-agent) sets it: the payTo wallet signs EIP-712 `AgentWalletSet(uint256 agentId,address newWallet,address owner,uint256 deadline)` (domain `ERC8004IdentityRegistry` v1, chainId 4663, the registry), deadline at most 5 minutes ahead, and the owner sends `setAgentWallet(agentId, newWallet, deadline, signature)` to `0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432`, checked by check_tx first.
- Every payment's payTo is checked against the seller's registered ERC-8004 identity (ERC-8478); the outcome is in `extensions.erc8478`. A mismatch (or an invalid delegation) is refused with `payee_mismatch` (enforced since 2026-11-08); an identity that could not be read never refuses a payment.
- Every settlement carries a signed receipt in `extensions.receipt` (EIP-712 "Toll x402 Receipt"); `GET /receipt/<id or tx>` returns it.
- Paid before? `GET /paid?payer=<0x>&payTo=<0x>` (optional `resource=<url>`, `since=<unix s>`) answers `{ paid, count, last: { tx, ts, amount, receiptId, via } }` from this facilitator's own settlements, escrow captures and batch charges, so a seller using sign-in-with-x can let a returning wallet in without charging it again. Only facts already on chain.
- Spending budgets per payer (live since 2026-11-11): a payer wallet signs its own limits (EIP-712 domain `Toll Facilitator Budget` v1, chainId 4663, no verifyingContract; `Budget(address payer,uint256 perPayment,uint256 perDay,uint256 perPayTo,PayToCap[] payToCaps,address[] allowedPayTos,uint64 validUntil,uint256 nonce)`, `PayToCap(address payTo,uint256 perDay)`, USDG base units, UTC days) with `POST /budget` `{ budget, signature }` (a higher nonce replaces; `{ revoke: { payer, nonce }, signature }` revokes) and reads it with `GET /budget?payer=<0x>` (`spentToday`, `remainingToday`); verify and settle then refuse payments past it on every scheme (`budget_exceeded_per_payment`, `budget_exceeded_per_day`, `budget_exceeded_per_payto`, `budget_payto_not_allowed`, `budget_expired`, `budget_revoked`, `budget_asset_not_usdg`).
- x402 offer-receipt extension: when a payment carries the seller's signed offers (`extensions["offer-receipt"]`), the settle answer adds `extensions["toll-offer-receipt"]`: the matching offer's signer, whether it is the payTo, and whether amount, resource and validUntil match (facts, never a refusal), plus the spec's receipt payload for the seller to sign with its own key (`GET /receipt/<id or tx>` has it as `offerReceipt`). The facilitator does not sign the spec's receipt: it attests delivery, which only the seller can.
- `GET /supported` lists what it settles. Limits (the defaults): 0.001 to 100 USDG a payment, EOA payers only; at most 200 settlements a day and 60 an hour for one payTo, 20 an hour for a payTo that is not verified (its payTo is not its ERC-8004 agent wallet); 20 an hour and 100 settlements a day for one payer; and a gas budget for the UTC day, because we pay the gas: past it a new settle answers `gas_day_budget_exhausted` until 00:00 UTC, and payTos that are not verified share half of it, so they cannot use up a verified seller's share. A capture, refund or void of an existing hold is never refused by these limits (only a new payment or a new hold is). Page: https://t0ll.xyz/x402
- Selling over x402? `npm i @tollxyz/x402-seller`: `paywall({ payTo, price: "0.05", agentId }, handler)` puts a USDG price on any Next.js, Hono, Bun or Workers handler, settled here, charged only for a good answer. A ready Next.js API to start from: `npx degit t0ll-xyz/toll-plugins/templates/x402-starter my-api`.
- Seller dashboard: https://x402.t0ll.xyz/dashboard. Sign in as your payTo wallet, or as the owner of the ERC-8004 agent whose agent wallet is the payTo (give its agent id). It shows only that payTo's settlements through this facilitator: the last 30 days, revenue by day, top payers, each settlement with its receipt, refused settles with the reason, and a CSV. Read-only apart from the webhook.
- Settle webhook (set on the dashboard): Toll POSTs a signed JSON event to your https endpoint on every settle, and on every refused settle if you choose it. Events: `settle.succeeded | settle.refused | test`. Headers: `x-toll-event`, `x-toll-delivery` (the event id, the same on every retry: dedupe on it), `x-toll-timestamp` (unix seconds) and `x-toll-signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<timestamp>.<raw body>")>`. The secret is shown once, when you save. 3 tries (now, 10 s, 60 s), 5 s timeout each; redirects are not followed. Refuse a timestamp older than 5 minutes. The event is sent after the payment is answered, so it never slows a settle. Events are sent for exact, upto and Permit2 payments answered by `/settle`; escrow and batch payments send none yet. A webhook is a signal: for the truth, read the receipt (`GET /receipt/<id or tx>`).
- Settle webhook from code (no browser, no cookie): `GET https://x402.t0ll.xyz/api/facilitator/webhook/nonce?payTo=&action=set&url=&events=settle.succeeded,settle.refused` answers `{ nonce, message, expiresAt }`; sign `message` as it is (EIP-191 personal_sign) with the payTo wallet (ERC-1271 works; or the ERC-8004 agent's owner, adding `agent` and `signer`), then `POST https://x402.t0ll.xyz/api/facilitator/webhook` `{ payTo, action, url, events, nonce, signature }`. The secret comes back once. `action`: `set`, `rotate` (a new secret) or `delete`. Each nonce works once, for 10 minutes.
- Public seller record: `GET https://x402.t0ll.xyz/api/x402/seller/{payTo}` (free, no key, 30 reads a minute per caller, kept 5 minutes) answers `{ payTo, chain, facilitator, source, read, settles: { d30, all }, volumeUsdg: { d30, all }, payers: { d30, all }, failed30d, refused30d: { total, byReason }, firstSettle, lastSettle, payee: { outcome, verified, at, standard }, agent: { id, nameLabel, nameNote } | null }`, from this facilitator's own settlements only, not the whole chain. Counts only, never a payer address. `agent.nameLabel` is the agent's own registration text, not checked; the agent id is the identity. A payTo with no settlement here answers zeros; a record that could not be read answers 503 `{ read: false }`, never zeros. Page: https://x402.t0ll.xyz/seller/{payTo}.
- Payee re-check without a payment: `POST https://x402.t0ll.xyz/api/x402/seller/{payTo}/recheck` (optional body `{ "resource": "https://your-api/paid" }`). Toll fetches the seller's own live 402 (its settled resources, or the one named, which must pay this payTo), runs the same ERC-8478 check as at settle, and the record's `payee` shows it with `source: "recheck"`. Once per 10 minutes per payTo.
- Switch kit: https://x402.t0ll.xyz/switch has copy-paste snippets that point a seller at this facilitator with one change, the facilitator URL, for `@x402/express`, `@x402/hono`, `@x402/next` and Python FastAPI (`x402` on PyPI), and an index of sellers that settle their own payments (last 30 days). One seller's page, with its payTo filled into the snippets: https://x402.t0ll.xyz/switch/{payTo or host} (the host its own listing names; Toll has not checked it). As JSON: `GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/switch` (the index) and `GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/switch?seller=<payTo|host>` (one seller) answer `{ asOf, chain, days, facilitator, sellers: [{ payTo, label, named, host, hostSource, payments, usdg, payers, selfPayments, tollPayments, otherPayments, gasEstimateWei, gasEstimateEth, gasEstimated, status, page }] }`. The gas is an estimate, never a measured figure. 400 for a key that is not a payTo or host, 404 when no seller matches, 503 when not read. No payer address. 30 reads a minute per caller.
- The x402 Register (https://x402.t0ll.xyz/#register) lists every Robinhood Chain agent selling over x402 and whether its payTo is its registered agent wallet.
- x402 on Robinhood Chain, measured: x402 payments settled directly on USDG or through the two x402 proxies over the last 30 days, by seller and by facilitator, with the block range, refreshed hourly (page: https://t0ll.xyz/x402/market; free JSON: `GET https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/market`).
